summary: NARUC is mentioned solely in the context of having requested a major study of time-of-day metering and load management systems by the Edison Electric Institute and the Electric Power Research Institute. The document uses this reference to illustrate that rate revision and conservation measures are being studied as potential alternatives to new generating capacity. NARUC does not express a position on the Bad Creek Project itself.
